metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the iCalendar CLI in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js) with an executable wrapper at [output/ical](/workspace/output/ical).

It supports:

- `node output/main.js parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
- `node output/main.js expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO> --to <ISO> --output <out.json>`
- `output/ical parse ...` and `output/ical expand ...`

I kept it dependency-free: only Node.js standard library, no `package.json`, no `node_modules`.

Verified with syntax checks and targeted fixtures covering parsing, RRULE expansion, `BYSETPOS`, negative `BYDAY`, `RDATE` periods, `EXDATE`, timezone DST transitions, fold/gap warnings, recurrence overrides, and `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE`.

    def test_calendar_image_display_values_comma_list(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        """RFC 7986 §6.1 allows the DISPLAY parameter to carry multiple values
        (comma-separated): `DISPLAY=BADGE,THUMBNAIL`. The entire DISPLAY string
        should be surfaced; we accept either the raw joined string or a semantic
        split (depending on harness preference)."""
        out = run_parse(
            submission_command,
            _wrap_calprops(
                "IMAGE;VALUE=URI;DISPLAY=BADGE,THUMBNAIL;FMTTYPE=image/png:"
                "https://example.com/weather-cloudy.png\n"
            ),
            tmp_path,
        )
        images = _dict_list_field(_cal(out), "images")
        assert len(images) == 1
        display = cast(str, images[0].get("display") or "")

editorial.last_message:
Implemented the iCalendar CLI in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js) with an executable wrapper at [output/ical](/workspace/output/ical).

It supports:

- `node output/main.js parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
- `node output/main.js expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO> --to <ISO> --output <out.json>`
- `output/ical parse ...` and `output/ical expand ...`

I kept it dependency-free: only Node.js standard library, no `package.json`, no `node_modules`.

Verified with syntax checks and targeted fixtures covering parsing, RRULE expansion, `BYSETPOS`, negative `BYDAY`, `RDATE` periods, `EXDATE`, timezone DST transitions, fold/gap warnings, recurrence overrides, and `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE`.
